rationale: Motor vehicle collision with significant damage to the policyholder's vehicle and injury to the policyholder resulting from the accident.
claim_summary: Pat Morgan's vehicle was rear-ended at high speed (35 mph, no braking) on Route 9 yesterday at 8:15 AM, resulting in total loss of the vehicle with trunk crushed into the back seat. Policyholder sustained whiplash and sprained wrist injuries. Police report filed with other driver's insurance information available. Vehicle totaled; whiplash requires medical follow-up and potential escalation investigation.

case_facts.description: rear-ended by other vehicle traveling ~35 mph with no braking
case_facts.vehicle_damage: vehicle totaled; entire trunk crushed into back seat
case_facts.police_report: filed; other driver's insurance info available
